code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, and mild thrombocytopenia. Basophilia is present. Glucose is slightly low. Renal and liver function, electrolytes, and protein levels are within normal limits. Findings suggest bone marrow suppression or infiltration and possible acute or chronic hypoxic state; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
